blogPosts.title: How Much Does Tiling Cost in Dandenong? A Complete 2026 Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover how much tiling costs in Dandenong in 2026. We break down materials, labour and waterproofing prices for bathrooms, kitchens and outdoor areas across Melbourne's south-east.
body: If you are planning a tiling project in Dandenong, one of the first questions on your mind is probably: how much will it cost? Whether you are renovating a bathroom, tiling a kitchen floor or creating an outdoor entertainment area, understanding tiling costs in Dandenong helps you budget with confidence and avoid unpleasant surprises. The truth is, tiling prices vary significantly depending on the type of tiles you choose, the size of the area being tiled and the complexity of the installation. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we have been providing transparent, competitive quotes across Dandenong for years, and in this comprehensive guide, we will walk you through the key factors that influence tiling costs in Melbourne's south-east.

The cost of tiles themselves is one of the biggest variables in your tiling budget. In Dandenong, ceramic tiles remain the most affordable option, typically ranging from $30 to $80 per square metre for standard sizes. Porcelain tiles, which are denser and more durable, generally cost between $60 and $150 per square metre, with premium large-format porcelain slabs commanding higher prices. Natural stone tiles such as marble, travertine and slate can range from $80 to $200 or more per square metre depending on the stone type and finish. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we source tiles from trusted Australian suppliers and can help Dandenong homeowners find the perfect balance between aesthetics, durability and budget for every project.

Labour costs make up a significant portion of your total tiling investment. In the Dandenong area, professional tiling rates typically range from $50 to $85 per square metre for standard installations, with more complex layouts such as herringbone patterns, large-format tiles or intricate mosaic work commanding higher rates. Factors that affect labour costs include the condition of the existing substrate, the need for waterproofing, the complexity of cuts around fixtures and corners, and the height or accessibility of the space. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we provide detailed, itemised quotes for every Dandenong project so you know exactly what you are paying for before we begin any work.

Bathroom tiling is one of the most common projects we undertake in Dandenong, and costs depend heavily on the scope of the renovation. A straightforward bathroom floor retiling might cost between $1,500 and $3,000, while a complete bathroom overhaul including walls, floor, shower recess and niches could range from $5,000 to $12,000 or more. Waterproofing is an essential additional cost for any wet area, typically adding $500 to $1,500 depending on the size of the space. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we always recommend including waterproofing in any bathroom tiling project in Dandenong to protect your property from moisture damage and comply with Australian Building Code requirements.

Outdoor tiling and floor tiling across Dandenong homes come with their own pricing considerations. For internal floor tiling, you can expect to pay between $40 and $90 per square metre for materials and installation in standard areas, with open-plan living spaces offering better value due to fewer intricate cuts. Outdoor tiling for patios, alfresco areas and pool surrounds typically costs between $70 and $160 per square metre, as outdoor tiles need to be slip-resistant, weather-proof and UV-stable to handle Melbourne's variable climate. Premium options like travertine or textured porcelain add both durability and visual appeal to outdoor spaces, making them a worthwhile investment for Dandenong homeowners.

The best way to manage tiling costs in Dandenong is to get multiple detailed quotes and compare them carefully. Be wary of quotes that seem unusually low, as they may indicate substandard materials or shortcuts in surface preparation that can lead to costly problems down the track. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we provide free, detailed quotes for all Dandenong tiling projects, including a clear breakdown of materials, labour and any additional requirements like waterproofing or substrate preparation. We believe in transparent pricing with no hidden extras, so the price we quote is the price you pay. Contact us today to arrange your free on-site consultation and discover how affordable professional tiling in Dandenong can be.

blogPosts.title: Best Bathroom Tiles for Dandenong Homes: Styles, Sizes and Waterproofing Tips
blogPosts.excerpt: Choosing the right bathroom tiles for your Dandenong home? Our guide covers tile types, sizes, slip ratings and essential waterproofing tips for Melbourne's climate.
body: Choosing the right tiles for your bathroom renovation in Dandenong is about more than just picking a colour that looks nice. The best bathroom tiles need to withstand daily exposure to water, humidity and foot traffic while still looking beautiful for years to come. With so many options available from Australian tile suppliers, making the right choice can feel overwhelming. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we have helped hundreds of Dandenong homeowners select and install the perfect bathroom tiles, and in this guide, we will share our expert advice on tile types, sizes, layouts and the crucial waterproofing steps that protect your investment.

When it comes to bathroom floor tiles in Dandenong, porcelain is widely regarded as the gold standard. Porcelain tiles are incredibly dense, making them highly resistant to water absorption, staining and wear. For bathroom floors, we recommend choosing tiles with a slip-resistant finish, particularly for shower floors and areas around bathtubs. Ceramic tiles are a more budget-friendly alternative that still performs well in bathroom environments, though they are slightly more porous than porcelain. Natural stone tiles such as travertine offer a luxurious, spa-like aesthetic but require sealing and more maintenance. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we help Dandenong homeowners weigh up these options based on their lifestyle, budget and design preferences.

Tile size plays a major role in the overall look and feel of your Dandenong bathroom. Large-format tiles, typically 600mm x 600mm or bigger, create a sense of space and reduce the number of grout lines, making the room feel more open and modern. These are particularly effective in smaller Dandenong bathrooms where you want to maximise the feeling of space. Subway tiles, usually 100mm x 200mm, remain a timeless choice for bathroom walls and shower niches, offering a classic look that suits both contemporary and traditional homes. Mosaic tiles are perfect for accent strips, shower floors and niche interiors, adding texture and visual interest to your bathroom design.

Waterproofing is the most critical step in any Dandenong bathroom tiling project, and it must never be skipped or done on the cheap. In Victoria, all wet area waterproofing must comply with Australian Standard AS 3740, and a certified waterproofing membrane must be applied before any tiles are laid. This typically involves applying a liquid or sheet membrane to the floor, walls up to required heights and all junctions, corners and penetrations. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we are certified waterproofing installers and ensure every Dandenong bathroom meets the required standards. We also provide a waterproofing certificate upon completion, which is essential for insurance purposes and any future property transactions.

Grout selection is another important consideration for Dandenong bathroom tiles. Epoxy grout has become increasingly popular because it is waterproof, stain-resistant and does not require sealing, making it ideal for wet areas. Cement-based grout is more affordable but requires regular sealing to prevent discolouration and mould growth, which can be a concern in Dandenong's sometimes humid climate. When it comes to grout colour, darker shades hide dirt and staining better, while lighter grout creates a cleaner, more seamless look. We always recommend discussing grout options with your tiler before work begins, as the right grout can make a significant difference to the longevity and appearance of your bathroom tiles.

At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we work with the best tile suppliers available to Dandenong homeowners and can guide you through the selection process from start to finish. We carry samples, provide expert advice on current trends and help you find tiles that suit your home's style and your budget. Whether you are after a sleek modern bathroom with large-format porcelain or a warm, classic space with handmade subway tiles, our experienced team ensures every tile is laid with precision and every wet area is properly waterproofed. Contact us today for a free bathroom tiling consultation in Dandenong and let us help you create the bathroom you have always wanted.

blogPosts.title: Outdoor Tiling in Dandenong: Patios, Pool Areas and Alfresco Spaces
blogPosts.excerpt: Planning outdoor tiling in Dandenong? Learn about the best materials for patios, pool surrounds and alfresco areas, plus costs and tips for Melbourne weather.
body: Dandenong homeowners are increasingly looking to outdoor tiling as a way to extend their living space and add value to their properties. Whether you are building a new patio, renovating a pool surround or creating an alfresco dining area, the right outdoor tiles can transform an underused backyard into a stunning entertainment zone. However, outdoor tiling in Melbourne's south-east presents unique challenges, from temperature fluctuations and rain exposure to UV damage and heavy foot traffic. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we specialise in outdoor tiling across Dandenong and understand exactly what materials and techniques are needed to create outdoor spaces that look incredible and stand the test of time.

Choosing the right outdoor tiles is critical for both safety and longevity. In Dandenong, where summer temperatures can soar and winter rains are frequent, outdoor tiles need to be slip-resistant, frost-proof and UV-stable. Porcelain pavers are an excellent choice for Dandenong outdoor areas because they are extremely durable, have very low water absorption rates and come in a huge range of styles including timber-look and stone-look finishes. Natural stone options such as travertine, bluestone and sandstone offer a premium, organic look but require sealing to protect against staining and moisture. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we help Dandenong homeowners choose outdoor tiles that balance aesthetics with practical performance for Melbourne's variable climate.

Pool surround tiling is one of the most specialised areas of outdoor tiling and requires careful attention to both materials and waterproofing. In Dandenong, pool area tiles must meet strict slip-resistance standards and be able to withstand constant exposure to water, chlorine and UV radiation. Coping tiles, which form the edge of the pool, need to be bull-nosed or have a comfortable rounded edge for safety. The substrate beneath pool tiles must be properly waterproofed and sloped to ensure effective drainage, preventing water pooling and potential structural damage. EM Tiling & Stone Works has extensive experience installing pool surround tiles across Dandenong, ensuring every project meets Australian safety standards while looking absolutely stunning.

Alfresco and patio tiling can dramatically increase the liveability and value of your Dandenong home. A well-tiled outdoor area creates a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor living, which is perfect for Melbourne's love of outdoor entertaining. When planning your alfresco tiling project, consider the orientation of the space, as areas that receive full afternoon sun may benefit from lighter-coloured tiles that reflect heat, while north-facing areas might suit darker tones that absorb warmth. The thickness of outdoor tiles is also important; most outdoor applications require tiles that are at least 10mm thick to handle foot traffic and furniture weight. EM Tiling & Stone Works can help Dandenong homeowners design and install outdoor tiling that perfectly complements their home.

The cost of outdoor tiling in Dandenong depends on several factors, including the size of the area, the type of tiles chosen and any preparation work required on the substrate. As a general guide, outdoor tiling in the Dandenong area typically costs between $80 and $180 per square metre for materials and installation, with premium natural stone at the higher end of that range. Additional costs may include substrate preparation, drainage solutions, waterproofing and edge finishing. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we provide free, detailed quotes for all outdoor tiling projects in Dandenong, giving you a clear picture of the investment required before any work begins. We believe in transparent pricing with no hidden surprises.

If you are considering outdoor tiling for your Dandenong home, the team at EM Tiling & Stone Works is ready to help. We bring years of experience in outdoor tiling across Melbourne's south-east and have the expertise to handle everything from simple patio installations to complex pool surround projects. We work with the finest tile suppliers in Australia and use proven installation techniques to ensure your outdoor tiles look beautiful and perform flawlessly for decades. Contact us today for a free on-site consultation and quote for outdoor tiling in Dandenong. Let us help you create an outdoor space that your family and friends will love for years to come.

blogPosts.title: Kitchen Splashback Ideas for Dandenong: Materials, Costs and Installation Tips
blogPosts.excerpt: Looking for kitchen splashback ideas in Dandenong? Explore materials, pricing and expert installation tips to create a stunning splashback for your home.
body: A kitchen splashback is one of the easiest and most impactful ways to refresh your Dandenong kitchen without a full renovation. Whether you are after a subtle, classic look or a bold statement piece, the right splashback tiles can completely transform the heart of your home. In Dandenong, where homes range from modern builds to charming period properties, there is a splashback style to suit every taste and budget. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we have installed hundreds of kitchen splashbacks across Dandenong and the surrounding suburbs, and in this guide, we will walk you through the most popular materials, design ideas and practical tips to help you choose the perfect splashback for your kitchen.

Ceramic and porcelain tiles remain the most popular choice for kitchen splashbacks in Dandenong, and for good reason. They are affordable, durable, easy to clean and available in an enormous range of colours, patterns and finishes. Subway tiles continue to be a top choice for Dandenong kitchens, offering a timeless look that works with everything from modern minimalist to traditional farmhouse styles. For those wanting something more contemporary, large-format porcelain panels create a sleek, seamless look with minimal grout lines. Handmade zellige tiles are gaining popularity for their textured, artisanal appearance that adds warmth and character to any Dandenong kitchen.

Glass tiles are another excellent option for Dandenong kitchen splashbacks, offering a glossy, reflective surface that bounces light around the room and makes the space feel larger. Glass tiles are inherently non-porous, making them incredibly easy to clean and resistant to staining from cooking splashes. They come in a huge variety of colours and can be used to create stunning feature walls or subtle accent strips. Natural stone splashbacks, such as marble or granite, offer unmatched luxury and can be matched to your stone benchtops for a cohesive look. However, natural stone requires sealing and more careful maintenance, which is an important consideration for busy Dandenong families.

The cost of a kitchen splashback in Dandenong varies depending on the materials chosen and the complexity of the installation. For a standard tiled splashback, materials typically range from $30 to $100 per square metre for ceramic or porcelain options, with glass and natural stone commanding higher prices. Installation costs generally add $60 to $100 per square metre, with additional charges for intricate cuts around power points, switches and cabinetry. For a typical Dandenong kitchen splashback covering approximately 4 to 6 square metres, you can expect a total cost of between $500 and $1,500. At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we provide free, detailed quotes so Dandenong homeowners know exactly what their splashback project will cost.

When planning your Dandenong kitchen splashback, consider how it will interact with the rest of your kitchen design. The splashback is a focal point, so think about whether you want it to blend seamlessly with your benchtops and cabinetry or stand out as a bold feature. Colour selection is important; neutral tones like white, grey and beige are timeless choices that will not date, while bolder colours and patterned tiles can inject personality and style. The height of your splashback matters too. While the standard height between benchtop and overhead cabinets is around 600mm, extending the tile all the way to the ceiling or up to rangehood level creates a dramatic, modern look that is increasingly popular in Dandenong renovations.

At EM Tiling & Stone Works, we take pride in creating kitchen splashbacks that Dandenong homeowners love. Our experienced team ensures every tile is cut and installed with precision, resulting in clean lines, perfectly level surfaces and a professional finish that elevates your entire kitchen. We work with all tile types and can help you navigate the huge selection available from Australian suppliers to find the perfect match for your home. Whether you are planning a complete kitchen renovation or simply want to refresh your splashback, contact us today for a free quote in Dandenong. We will help you bring your kitchen vision to life with expert tiling and unmatched attention to detail.
